$comment: The contact page and its form, including every message the API can return. The server messages are shown to a reader verbatim, so they belong here rather than being left in English inside an API route.

page.intro: Corrections are the most valuable thing you can send, especially with a link to the official page that contradicts what is published here.
page.emailIsTheWayTitle: Email is the way to reach us
page.notConfiguredTitle: Contact is not configured on this deployment
page.cannotHelpHeading: What this site cannot help with
page.cannotHelpDescription: Not a brush-off — these are genuinely outside what an independent calculator can reach.

form.p2: No message form or published address is available here, and showing one that quietly discarded your message would be worse than saying so. If you have found a factual error, the fastest route is to check the
form.p3: — it links every official page these figures come from, so you can confirm the current value directly.
form.p4: Your message and email address are used only to read and reply to what you sent.

cannotHelp.p1: Your Roblox account, in any respect. This site has no connection to Roblox and no access to any account.
cannotHelp.p2: A DevEx request that has been submitted, delayed, or declined. Only Roblox support can look at it.
cannotHelp.p3: Recovering Robux, reversing a purchase, or anything involving your balance.
cannotHelp.p4: Tax advice. Nobody here is qualified to give it, and the answer depends on your country and circumstances.
cannotHelp.p5: Predicting whether a request will be approved or what a future rate will be.
cannotHelp.p6: This site will never ask for your Roblox password, a login code, or access to your account — and neither will any legitimate tool. Please do not include them in a message.

prose.emailIsTheWay: Messages go to {email}. Please include the page you were on and, for a correction, a link to the official source.
